title: domain.document_prefix
description: Document-number prefix of an organization or billing entity (BE-DM-32, BE-DM-33). Without a supplied prefix: the first three characters of the name (fewer if the name is shorter; spaces kept) upper-cased, a dash, and the last four characters of the record id upper-cased. A supplied prefix is upper-cased and must be 1-10 characters (longer: domain error value_is_too_long, empty: value_is_too_short, both on field document_number_prefix).

supplied_prefix.description: Prefix given at creation; null or absent = generate one.
